summary: Myseum.AI, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce the appointment of Ian Goldberg as Head of Marketing, Partnerships & Monetization, a newly created role. The press release highlights Goldberg's background as founder/CEO of iSport360, which was acquired in 2025. The filing is a routine executive hire announcement, not a forced departure or board-level change. No deal terms, financial details, or structural mechanics are discussed. The event is a standard corporate appointment, not a special situation. Watch for no risk-arb angle; this is purely operational and non-transformative.
